description: Source code for TinyMCE advanced image plugin, including plugin info, control HTML, command execution, content cleanup, and node change handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for control buttons, specifically for the 'image' control.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands like opening the advanced image dialog.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up content by processing image tags for URL conversion and event attributes.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles node change events to update button states based on selected image nodes.

methods.name: _getImageSrc
methods.description: Extracts image source URL from event handler strings.
